info.title: Infura Ethereum Universal API
info.description: Access Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoints and manage Infura API keys

get.description: Retrieves a contract call result from Infura Ethereum.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: params[0][data]
parameters.description: ABI-encoded function selector and arguments for the contract call.

schema.description: ABI-encoded function selector and arguments for the contract call.

parameters.name: params[0][to]
parameters.description: The target contract address for the read-only call.

parameters.name: params[1]
parameters.description: The block number or canonical tag to query against.

schema.description: The block number or canonical tag to query against.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

response.description: The raw hex-encoded return data from the contract call.
